chunks: Ibn Mahbub narrated from 'Abd Allah ibn Muskan, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him say: “The hadd of flogging in zina is that the two are found in a single covering, and that two men are found in a single covering, and that two women are found in a single covering.”
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith in Tahdhib al-Ahkam say about being found under one covering in zina cases?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the hadd of flogging in cases involving zina-related impropriety indicated by being found together under one covering. It also extends the same ruling to two men or two women being found in a single covering, reflecting a jurisprudential treatment of illicit sexual circumstances and prohibited intimacy.
